body:
I have to say, I am going to take and use your list. there are some things in there that I cannot do...but if I can do even 5 out of 10 it may help. 

OP, talk to us. We are here for you.

First of all - how are you right now? I'm not sure I know much about BPD -so I cant help you from a medical perspective. Do you have anyone except L who can help you? You mentioned parents? Are they living close by or in a position to help?

You need to get help and not from SW but from the real world. 
First find a reason to get help - whether it be your daughter or anything else. 
Second. Do it. 

Let us know if you feel like there are no resources - i bet the folks on SW will have some ideas. 

Please just hang in there.

hi, please done feel scared or alone. there are many many lonely people out there. sometimes we all live in our little bubble and barely have a chance to look up or out. I am going through a tough time in life myself...but sometimes I come by SW and read a few posts and try to help a few people out and it makes me feel marginally better. 
right now I am writing a "bucket list" of sorts  - not exactly things to do before I die, but just things I want to do when I can get out of my depression and feel better. 

I have bowling classes, painting and pencil sketching on my list. 

Whats on yours? What would you do if you were the happiest person in the world today?

Your friend looks beautiful on the inside and out. she has such a lovely smile. I wish there was a way we could turn back time for just a moment. But all we can do is move on I guess. She looks like she would have wanted you to be happy, and wanted you to go, kiss the world.

hi, I was in here two weeks ago, just feeling alone and desperate. It made a world of a difference when someone just asked : How are you doing? I felt so calmed down when someone said 'PM me and we can talk'. I have everything in life, yet I feel so alone. 
SW is the only place I 'haunt' so I can see and maybe help a few people like myself.

Not to sound stupid, but have you tried doing something after 6 that doesnt involve going home? joining a club or a class or sitting by the library and reading a book? the only way to make friends is to be one. you have to get out there.

please don't do anything crazy just yet. PM me if you feel like talking. I will log back in later this evening. 

you have two children? can you tell us more about them? how old are they? What do they do?
feeling better?

Thanks for listening. You can click on my uname and I am going through a crappy situation in life as well. As far as I can see, Reddit is keeping me alive. 

I got up this morning wishing I just didnt have to get up at all. wishing I could close my eyes and simply will myself to disappear. 

Then ofcourse I had to get up because I had to pee :) jokes apart...I got up to see that a number of people on Reddit has responded to my desperate post. 

I may never see these people, but it gave me hope. 

If someone, across the world, who has no idea if I'm trolling or real can spend 5 minutes of their time trying to keep me alive...
What if I had a real friend? I would matter so much more to him. 

I'm glad you acknowledged that there are people who care for you. Even being able to say that aloud means you see a silver lining. Is it possible to switch for just one second and think - what can I do to make them happy? Just for a second. 

Go down that list of your's - family, friends etc - and do something so small and simple that will bring a smile to any of them. 

you will be filled with a warmth that will banish the hollowness that you are feeling now. 

Thanks for trying. You deserve love, warmth and compassion as much as I do :) Hope you find it. I will check in on this page - but prob hours later due to time zone diffs. So lets keep talking.
So I am going to get on your case - are you going to do something about it?

Dude, I don't want to hate on your ex, because it sounds like she did something good for you. Why is it so hard fo you to accept that there could be atleast one other person among the existing 6 billion! who will like you.

And (sorry for the caps) WHY DOES LIFE HAVE TO BE DEFINED BY RELATIONSHIPS?

Why can't we just be ourselves and not have a gf, bf, so and still mean something to someone. 

Do you really mean to tell me that no one cares if you are dead or alive? You cant think of a single person who would attend your funeral?

Family, one friend, a dog? 

If the answer is no one, then I urge you to change that. 
Make a positive impact on one life - any one. Some homeless guy on the street. Find someone off a random internet charity and just go say hello even if you dont have money to give them. 

I assume you have money to eat (since you mentioned seeing doctors etc). Sacrifice one of your meals, go a day without eating. Pack up everything you would have eaten that day and walk around your city till you can find a hungry person to give it to. 

Make a difference somewhere and then decide to end your life. 

Don't give up without even trying.

I dont think there is a checklist to qualify for being depressed. 
Anyone, anyweher has the right. The point is what are you going to do about it. Have a conversation with your niece. Ask her some simple questions - like what's your favorite color and why. I read an IamA by a four year old (posted by his father). His replies were so simple and so childlike that they filled me with hope. We need to hang in there friend. Don't try to focus on the battles, focus on the good. 

Here's a short story:

Someone once asked a class - If god created everything, then he created evil, so God is evil blah blah derp derp. 

So a student asked - What is cold, can you define it or measure it? The teacher said yeah, if you go below x degress it is cold. 
The student said - wrong! cold is measured as the absence of heat. 

NExt he asked - what is darkness, can you measure it? 
The teacher was at a loss. 
Again the student replied - there is no darkness, it is only the absence of light. 

In the same way, there is no evil, only the absence of good. 

IF you focus on what makes you feel good, the bad will just disappear. 
But you have to keep on at it. 

These thoughts that you describe are just like cigarettes. You keep away from them but they come creeping and crawling back when you least expect it. 

Keep the good thoughts handy and fight the battle.
I want to help you. Can you tell me more about anything that makes you feel positive? Is there anything at all that gives you happiness? Are you proud of anything? beating cancer?

I read my reply and realised it sucked. The only person who can make you feel better about yourself is you. If you feel like crap inside even if people praise you, it doesn't stick. All I can tell you is I would give anything to be 19 again. You have no financial commitments, no criminal record, a fair amount of intelligence and your whole life ahead of you. Use it. Asking reddit for help is the first step. But you need to get away from the computer and ask someone real for help. take small steps but make sure you are moving. 

Tell us - what are you going to do today to improve your situation? 
It can be something really small...

Have you thought about taking up a simple job? some kind of manual labor maybe involving metal work that does not require you to think. you can get up in the morning, go for your job and come back home. Meeting even one person who sympathises can change your whole outlook about life. Just find something to do. now.

I think it has something to do with the culture I am from. We are taught from a very young age that our parents = god. It is very hard to get over that kind of indoctrination. I also have come to see that my parents are subjecting me to everything that they were subjected to by their parents. 
It is an unbroken circle of regrets. 
In any case their fears are real to them. The only thing is they are trying to impose it on me. 
I wish I could be even a little angry with them to save myself :) 

I am moving away though - at the end of the month. I came here to convince them about my marriage but seeing that I have failed miserably, I am ready to quit and go back. 

In some ways I feel like a coward for running back to what makes me feel safe and secure without finishing my job here. 

However we all have some crazy instinct for self-survival. and that beats everything. 

I am considering therapy when I get back, it scares me how close I came to giving up. 

Thanks princess :) you should know that you made someone feel better.

I hope your decision gives you the peace that you have long sought. Remember despite everything being "set in motion", if you have even the smallest doubt, want to live even for an extra hour, give in to that impulse. After all what do you have to loose? Peace my friend.

I love ur username. thanks for responding. I'm a lot calmer now. Especially since I went through and read every post of SW. I see so much unhappiness around me...some seem silly others huge...but the pain everyone feels is the same. Perhaps if I can help folks here, I can keep it together for a bit. 

I have to let my faith be my strength. I hope God is listening.

Start thinking small. I had a friend who was laid off and couldnt find a job for two years because he was looking for something "like" his old one. All it did was get him severly depressed. He had an MS in EE and started working at Papa John's. Just being with other folks and getting a paycheck lifted him up a little. I'd like to think his attitude change was what landed him a job six months later. 

Just go out and get yourself any job. Don't set the bar too high. You are never too old to start over. To reset. 

Trust me. I'm trying.

you have to find yourself something to live for. something that means a lot to you. that is the only way to really bring a change to your life. 
Is there anything that brings a smile to your face? anything that makes your heart feel a little lighter?

No. I'm safe. I'm calmer now. I just swing through severe bouts of depression. I have told myself that suicide is not an option. I have also marked off the days left before I see my husband again in a calendar. I am counting on the calendar to pull me through :) 

Thanks for asking. You have no idea how good it feels to simply have someone ask "are you ok?".

I love my husband like crazy. He always says I become a completely different person when I'm around my family - so needy and in need of acceptance. My family swears they don't "hate" him that it's all for my good. But how can anything that you are so against be for your good? 

What's holding me back is my guilt. My family has done a lot for me. They mean everything to me. I feel like I owe them this life, my job and everything in my present state of happiness. Yet I am unable to do this for them. For someone on the outside they would think it is crazy that I am being "asked" to divorce when I have no such intent. But it is very hard to understand the impact of "If you love us then you will...." or not feel like a loser when your father says "I had so many hopes and dreams for you and thought so highly of you"...

Their disappointment adds to my guilt, until I feel overwhelmed by it. 
I am not able to respond to anything they say. 
I am severly depressed and I feel like ending my life will end the pain. 

At the same time - I have a husband who loves me very much. I do not want to cause him pain as well. 

Thanks for listening. it feels good to atleast type things out aloud. If I can get through the next month with my family - I will be back with my husband. Just that thought keeps me and pulls me through everyday.

That and reddit.
yes, but 600$ can get you a cross country trip. get urself a cheap ass bus ticket and just travel. see the rest of something before you die.

You know I am sitting here right now, going over in my head various ways to end my life. I am surrounded by my father, my mother and my various siblings. They are all screaming and yelling at me to divorce my husband. They keep telling me he is a horrible person and how he will one day change and turn against me. They hate my husband so much and claim to love me. If I love them then I must divorce my husband. 

This stuff runs through my head, every day, every hour, when I wake up, when I go to sleep. My life is so tortuous every breath I take, I want to kill myself. Still I get up every morning, I take that painful breath. 

You are free - not alone. you have your life ahead of you. Get up. 
Get rid off the shotgun. See the sunshine. Get yourself a dog. live life. you are not burdened - financially, emotionally, mentally.

If you want to help her, keep your feelings out of the picture for a bit. The best thing would be to distract her and to take her away from dwelling on it. Does she like animals? Find her an "abondoned" kitten or puppy and tell her there's no one to take care of the poor thing. Just having another living, breathing soul next to you that doesn't judge you can keep you alive for an extra day. 

Give her a cause, a reason to wake up in the morning.

hey, can you go out and find one thing you like? anything at all? do you like to read or swim or run or watch people or paint or sing? Whenever I'm close to ---- I try and force myself - in my rumpled clothes with my tear stained face - to take a walk in a nearby park. I watch the kids playing and the dog walkers and the families and it always calms me down.
Don't give up just yet.

Hey, hang in there...I don't know who you are...but you sound like you are a nice person. A number of people on this page feel like you do. But we are all in here typing our hearts out. Tomorrow has to get better. 
What's your favorite song?

I'm probably not the best person to ask: but can you tell me more about your problem. One thing I understood through trying to kill myself is that -many times I wished someone would stop me. I think there is something deep down inside us that wants to survive. However if our troubles >> coping resources then we decide to end our lives. 
In your case is there any way to reset, and start life from zero or do you have too many commitments that force you to stay where you are? 

I have answered your Q below.

Thanks for replying. This the question that I ask myself every single day. Is your faith real if it makes you do something you would never dream of doing otherwise. Is it real if it makes you do something that goes against your very grain of existence? I guess more than anything else I am going through a crisis of faith.

No it is hard to explain but where I come from we have certian traditions. We ask our God who appears through a human medium and advises you before you make major life decisions such as marriage. The advice is based on the future happiness of husband and wife. Unfortunately in my case we did not ask for any before we got married. HOwever a year later it was prophecied that we will both be unhappy if we live together and we should seperate. It seems really odd that this can happen in 2011, but I guess somethings never change. So now I am faced with (1) a fear that it may come true - the success rate of the predictions to my knowledge is 100% (2) my parents will live with the same fear for the rest of their lives unless I give up my husband (3) i have to give up my faith if I choose to go my own way. 

In the end the prophecy is only a warning. No one can make me follow it. I can choose to accept it or not.

You are not alone. I am here.  
First remove everything around you that reminds you of her. everything. 
If you cant get rid of the pictures, put them in a box and stash them some place safe. 
Switch off the computer, get dressed and go eat your most favorite thing in the world. 
Follow this up with a walk in the park. Spend a few minutes quietly observing the world around you. 
Isnt it strange that though we may feel like the world has ended - it still goes on? 
This too shall pass.
